requirement.evidence: All notices to terminate a tenancy for all rental units subject to City’s Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) must be filed with the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD) within three (3) business days of service on the tenant
requirement.note: Document lists at-fault and no-fault reasons, the declaration of intent, 30/60/120-day notices, relocation assistance and the 3-business-day filing. The word 'only' is implied by the list of legal reasons.

key_value.evidence: No-fault evictions require the payment of relocation assistance.
key_value.note: Filing within 3 business days is also stated in the document.

status.note: Presented as current law on a page last modified September 22, 2026.

coverage.evidence: Generally, the RSO applies to rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978
coverage.note: The built-on-or-before cutoff matches the document. The document says 'generally', and lists other conditions.

citation.note: Both sections are cited for the 3-day filing. The general § 151.09 label is a reasonable parent reference.
